feeds.note: Prague integrated transport (PID). Explicit delay per stop_sequence, NO predicted time, hence trip_updates_seq. Reached without any key in the test, but the api.golemio.cz host normally hands out a free self-service token, so confirm the open endpoint is meant to be used keyless. The response is CDN-cached ~40 s (cache-control s-maxage=40): polling faster than 60 s is pointless.
